title: Boat sets sail from Bristol, aiming to break Israel’s siege of Gaza
description: Twelve people including the captain are on board the vessel named Kate, in the latest attempt to deliver aid.

title: Iran signals readiness for ‘US ground operations’ as MoU expires
description: Irans more offensive posture follows Trumps comment that the US would soon make the Strait of Hormuz its territory.
